about_the_game:
Emerge from the foliage with this autumn version of the iconic Oak Leaf camo pattern that was used by troops throughout WW2.

This downloadable content contains:

German Oak Leaf Uniform (Available to the German Officer, Rifleman, Anti-Tank, Engineer, Machine Gunner, Automatic Rifleman, Assault, Medic, Support, Sniper and Spotter roles)

German Oak Leaf Field Cap (Available to the German Officer, Rifleman, Anti-Tank, Engineer, Machine Gunner, Automatic Rifleman, Assault, Medic, Support, Sniper and Spotter roles)
